title: Your Way Out
description:
Does life ever feel like a video game where you aren’t in control? In a broken system, you don’t control much of anything — until you take the first step out.

Coinbase is your way out of their system.
Learn more at www.coinbase.com

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain 

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: P.S. If this is your first time on a journey, please remember the game's story and be aware that it's your own. It won't be a time-delayed action either, it is a matter of time until those who are willing to help me can take the advantage of the opportunity they've left me at. I think my story should start with this. All right, let's do it. Where are you going? Where you going? A long way. What's your problem? What you talking about? Be Free I just gotta be free Daring to try to do it or die I gotta be me

An informational and non-investment-advice disclaimer further frames it as general promotional or informational communication.
